event_summary.short: Officer Burton observed a woman hanging from a red Jeep screaming for help, initiating a high-speed chase that reached 112 mph. The suspect, Elijah Sanders, was apprehended after a PIT maneuver and foot pursuit. He was charged with kidnapping and multiple other offenses, but kidnapping and strangulation charges were later dropped.
